description: This file implements telemetry services for the Mattermost Focalboard server, including telemetry data collection, Rudder client initialization, and scheduled telemetry reporting.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Handles telemetry data collection, Rudder client management, and scheduled telemetry reporting.

classes.name: RudderConfig
classes.description: Configuration for Rudder client including API key and dataplane URL.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new telemetry Service instance with specified telemetry ID and logger.

methods.name: RegisterTracker
methods.description: Registers a telemetry data tracker function under a given name.

methods.name: getRudderConfig
methods.description: Retrieves Rudder configuration from constants or environment variables.

methods.name: sendDailyTelemetry
methods.description: Sends telemetry data for all registered trackers if configuration is valid or if overridden.

methods.name: sendTelemetry
methods.description: Enqueues a telemetry event with properties to the Rudder client.

methods.name: initRudder
methods.description: Initializes the Rudder client with provided endpoint and API key.

methods.name: doTelemetryIfNeeded
methods.description: Determines whether to send telemetry based on elapsed time since first run and last sent time.

methods.name: RunTelemetryJob
methods.description: Starts telemetry reporting, including immediate and recurring scheduled reports.

methods.name: doTelemetry
methods.description: Performs telemetry data sending and updates last sent timestamp.
